turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
“Doctor, I’ve been feeling confused and unable to communicate clearly lately. I also seem to have had an elevated temperature and some discomfort in my right upper abdomen.”

I’m sorry you’re going through that. **One question at a time:**  

**When did the confusion and trouble communicating start (hours/days/weeks), and has it been getting steadily worse or coming and going?**
“Doctor, the confusion started about two days ago and it’s been steadily getting worse. It hasn’t really come and gone—I feel less able to think clearly each day.”

Thank you. **Next question:**  

**Have you noticed any new weakness or numbness on one side, facial droop, trouble speaking (as in slurred words), or trouble understanding others?**

“Doctor, I haven’t noticed any one-sided weakness or numbness or facial droop. I do seem to have trouble getting my words out clearly, but I’m not sure if it’s slurred or if I just can’t organize my thoughts. I haven’t been able to tell how well I understand you.”
[DDX] Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome, Pneumonia, Takotsubo cardiomyopathy, Chronic kidney failure, Acalculous cholecystitis
